stem:
Isha compares steaming greens with frying the same greens for a long time.

How should she think about nutrients and these cooking practices?

options.text: Only frying keeps nutrients, so steaming cannot help.
Both are cooking practices; long high heat can reduce some nutrients more than gentle steaming.
Cooking cannot change the greens at all.
The shinier pan is always the healthier practice.

teacher.key_rationale: Steaming and frying are both cooking practices; long high heat can cut nutrients more than gentle steaming.
